q_001.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

q_002.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_approved_amount
FROM loan
WHERE status = 'A'

q_003.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS owner_dispositions
FROM disp
WHERE type = 'OWNER'

q_004.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payments), 2) AS avg_monthly_payment FROM loan

q_005.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 10000

q_006.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS distinct_owner_clients
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND di.A3 = 'Prague'

q_007.sql:
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = 1 AND strftime('%Y', date) = '1997'

q_008.sql:
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN account a
  ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN disp p
  ON p.account_id = a.account_id
 AND p.type = 'OWNER'
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Moravia'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY owner_count DESC, district_name
q_008.answer: 14 rows (showing first 5): district_name=Brno - mesto, owner_count=128; district_name=Zlin, owner_count=92; district_name=Kromeriz, owner_count=57; district_name=Brno - venkov, owner_count=53; district_name=Zdar nad Sazavou, owner_count=53

q_009.sql:
SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, SUM(l.amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5
q_009.answer: 5 rows: client_id=9,340, gender=M, total_loan_amount=590,820; client_id=10,997, gender=F, total_loan_amount=566,640; client_id=2,823, gender=F, total_loan_amount=541,200; client_id=981, gender=M, total_loan_amount=538,500; client_id=3,546, gender=M, total_loan_amount=504,000

q_010.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS running_good_standing_loans
FROM loan AS l
JOIN disp AS d
  ON d.account_id = l.account_id
 AND d.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN client AS c
  ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN district AS di
  ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'C'
  AND c.gender = 'M'
  AND di.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
